description: This Java class handles updating loan arrears aging details in the Fineract system, including methods for truncating, deleting, and batch updating loan arrears data, as well as constructing SQL queries for these operations.

classes.name: LoanOriginalScheduleExtractor
classes.description: A private static class implementing ResultSetExtractor to extract loan schedule data from SQL result set.

methods.name: truncateLoanArrearsAgingDetails
methods.description: Executes SQL to truncate the m_loan_arrears_aging table.

methods.name: deleteLoanArrearsAgingDetails
methods.description: Deletes existing loan arrears records for given loan IDs.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsForAllLoans
methods.description: Truncates existing data and inserts updated arrears aging details for all loans.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetails
methods.description: Updates arrears aging details for specified loan IDs, including handling original schedule data.

methods.name: buildQueryForInsertAgeingDetails
methods.description: Constructs SQL insert statement for arrears aging details, parameterized for all or specific loans.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Updates arrears details with original schedule data for specific loans.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalScheduleForAllLoans
methods.description: Updates arrears details with original schedule data for all loans.

methods.name: buildQueryForLoanIdentifiersWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Builds SQL to identify loans with original schedule arrears data, parameterized for all or specific loans.

methods.name: getLoanSummary
methods.description: Retrieves loan summary data such as principal and interest paid, waived, or written off.

methods.name: getScheduleDate
methods.description: Retrieves schedule date data for given loan IDs.
